title: Validation Verdict v1.0
description: Result of deterministic constraint validation, written to the audit log before any dispatch.

is_valid.description: True if all constraint checks passed; false if any violation was found

errors.description: Human-readable constraint violation messages; empty when is_valid is true

checked_at.description: UTC timestamp when the validation run completed (ISO 8601)

constraint_source.description: Path or identifier of the constraints config file applied
